regressions.issue: The event data used to be split into the head/struct words, the array length and the array data. It is now one raw slice whose length keeps the unfolded '_129 - mem[64]', although _129 holds mem[64] and nothing writes mem[64] in between. 3 lines.
regressions.rule: A variable bound to a read of mem[64] equals any later read of mem[64] as long as no write to mem[64] comes between, so fold x - mem[64] to 0 and drop the unused binding. Then split the log data at the known head/array boundaries as before.

regressions.issue: The indexed owner topic of the one ClusterLiquidated log is now the slice mem[300 len 20]. mem[288] = _param2 is written at the start and never rewritten before the log, so the old 'indexed _param2' was exact and clearer. The data length got simpler at the same time.
regressions.rule: Forward a memory word to its last write when no write between can alias it (constant address below the free-pointer floor, writes only at mem[64] + k above it). Print the topic as the stored value.

improvements: Cluster hashes resolved: storD56C_d56c4f4a_3[...] = sha3(Bytes(4, _param4), Bytes(49, 0)) on the liquidation paths (validatorCount with zeroed fields) and sha3(mem[156 len 4], .., mem[216 len 8], mem[256], Bytes(1, bool(mem[224]))) instead of sha3(mem[_x + 32 len mem[_x]]). Struct fields copied from parameters named (mem[.. + 32] = _param4 / _param3). 'revert with memory' 3 -> 0 (ETHTransferFailed()). Removed pointer copies (_891 .. _896). P6 44 -> 0 (whole bytes, also in def storage).
notes: Diff of 440 lines over 6 functions, read in full. While count unchanged (41) and all 10 source loops intact. The regex P2 count (3 lines with 'mem[mem[64] len') comes from the log lines above, which were raw before too (as mem[_894 len ..]) or partly listed; the pack header lists only P4 1, so P2 is 0 by the header. Checked that no write between mem[288] = _param2 and the ClusterLiquidated logs can reach mem[288].
summary: No semantic regression. Cluster hashes and struct fields are now resolved. Small readability losses: 3 events lost their split data (unfolded '_N - mem[64]' lengths), and liquidate's indexed owner (one log) now prints as mem[300 len 20].
